business_model.narrative_summary: RateGain is a structurally re-rated travel-tech SaaS company riding the global AI + travel digitisation wave, with its Sojern acquisition creating a Martech super-cycle.

products: MarTech (Social media management, paid digital marketing)

capital_allocation_philosophy.narrative: The company is at the inflection point where CapEx is flattening and ROCE is rising.

execution_track_record.narrative: Management has been conservative and transparent about segment weaknesses.

forward_guidance.narrative: Expect margin expansion and PE from current ~59x to sustainable 30–40x as earnings catch up.

communication_transparency.narrative: Management acknowledges risks and has been candid about the distribution decline.

governance_and_board.narrative: RateGain is professionally managed with a stable promoter holding.
